page.title: Settings
page.description: Automatically expands compatible multiplayer lobbies to 16 players.
extraPlayerScalingMultiplier.label: Extra Player Scaling
extraPlayerScalingMultiplier.description: Values above 4 players scale as 4 plus extra players times this multiplier.
toast.incompatibleAccepted.title: Expansion limited
toast.incompatibleAccepted.body: Player {0} does not support the current multiplayer extension protocol. The room cannot safely expand beyond 4 players while they remain.
toast.expansionBlocked.title: Cannot expand room
toast.expansionBlocked.body: The room already contains incompatible players: {0}. {1}'s join was rejected to prevent unsafe expansion.
toast.protocolMismatchRejected.body: Player {0} uses an incompatible multiplayer extension protocol and was rejected.
toast.unsafeVanillaRosterRejected.title: Unsafe original-client join rejected
toast.unsafeVanillaRosterRejected.body: The room still contains players in expanded slots: {0}. {1}'s join was rejected because their client cannot safely reconstruct this lobby state.
toast.unsupportedRejected.title: Incompatible player rejected
toast.unsupportedRejected.body: Player {0} does not support the required multiplayer extension protocol and was rejected.
toast.clientExistingBlockers.body: The room cannot safely expand because it contains incompatible players: {0}. The host rejected your join.
toast.clientProtocolMismatch.body: Your multiplayer extension protocol is incompatible with this room. The host rejected your join.
toast.clientUnsafeVanillaRoster.body: This room still contains players in expanded slots: {0}. Your client cannot safely reconstruct the current lobby state, so the host rejected your join.
toast.clientUnsupported.body: This room requires a supported multiplayer extension protocol. The host rejected your join.
toast.clientRejected.title: Unable to join expanded room
toast.unsafeExpandedMessage.title: Unable to synchronize expanded room
toast.unsafeExpandedMessage.body: The expanded lobby state received from the host was incomplete or invalid. Rejoin the lobby and make sure every player uses a compatible Multiplayer Limit Break version.
toast.expansionAvailable.title: Room can now expand
toast.expansionAvailable.body: All remaining players support multiplayer expansion. The room can now safely hold up to 16 players.
toast.vanillaAdmissionRestored.title: Original-client joining restored
toast.vanillaAdmissionRestored.body: No players remain in expanded slots. Original clients can now safely join while the room has fewer than 4 players.
lobbyStatus.blocked: [Multiplayer Limit Break] Disabled by incompatible clients ({0}/{1})
lobbyStatus.availableTooltip: The original message body remains unchanged. Multiplayer Limit Break will begin carrying additional player data in message tails when player 5 joins with a supported version.
lobbyStatus.blockedTooltip: Some clients in this room did not provide a supported Multiplayer Limit Break protocol, so the room limit remains 4. Affected players: {0}
lobbyStatus.activeTooltip: Expansion has been activated for this room. Additional players are carried by message-tail data, and later joins must provide a supported protocol; the original message body remains unchanged.
lobbyStatus.playerUnsupportedTooltip: This player did not provide Multiplayer Limit Break expansion support, so the room limit remains 4.
lobbyStatus.playerMismatchTooltip: This player's Multiplayer Limit Break protocol is not supported by this room, so the room limit remains 4.
